# GenericHamiltonianKrylovSubspaceSize

Module: **core** · directory: `src/Programs` · binary: `src/Programs/GenericHamiltonianKrylovSubspaceSize`

```text
GenericHamiltonianKrylovSubspaceSize, version 0.01

Usage: GenericHamiltonianKrylovSubspaceSize [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --hamiltonian : text file where the hamiltonian matrix elements are stored
    --shift : shift the hamiltonian by a constant integer value (i.e., H-lambda 1) (default value = 0)
    --base-one : hamiltonian indices start at one rather than zero
    --skip-lines : skip the first n-tf lines of the input file (default value = 0)
    --data-column : index of the column that contains the matrix elements (or their real part) (default value = 2)
    -s, --nosort-rowindices : do not sort the row indices, assuming they are already sorted from the smallest to the largest
    --rank-step : if non-zero, test the rank of the Krylov set at every rank-step (default value = 0)
    --basis-minrange : scan the Krylov subpsace size for each basis state with at least this min index (default value = 0)
    --basis-maxrange : scan the Krylov subpsace size for each basis state with up to this max index (if negative, up to Hilbert space dimension) (default value = -1)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

output options:
    -o, --output-file : output name for the characteristic polynomial

tools options:

misc options:
    --show-time : show the amount of time spent in various steps of the calculation
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
